blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

claim_audit.key: Pregnancy-related curettage can injure basal endometrium and create fibrous intrauterine adhesions that impair cyclic endometrial proliferation/shedding despite an intact endocrine axis.
claim_audit.poi: Primary ovarian insufficiency is an ovarian failure process and would not fit the preserved endocrine profile plus temporal uterine-instrumentation clue.
claim_audit.hypothalamic: Reduced pulsatile GnRH causes central hypogonadism rather than isolated post-curettage uterine scarring.
claim_audit.prolactin: Hyperprolactinemia suppresses GnRH, but measured prolactin is normal.
claim_audit.chronic_anovulation: Chronic anovulation can cause secondary amenorrhea but lacks the strong acquired structural trigger and does not explain the abrupt post-curettage change from previously regular cycles as well as Asherman syndrome.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A previously regularly cycling patient develops secondary amenorrhea and infertility immediately after pregnancy-related D&C while pregnancy and major endocrine causes are excluded. The lesion localizes to the uterine endometrium/outflow tract; basal endometrial injury with intrauterine synechiae is the best explanation.
adversarial_second_pass.second_answer_attack: PCOS/chronic anovulation can coexist with normal-range FSH, but there is no hyperandrogenic or chronic irregular-cycle phenotype and it does not account for the tight post-curettage onset. It is not equally defensible.
adversarial_second_pass.central_axis_attack: Hypothalamic or prolactin-mediated causes would require endocrine evidence or relevant systemic context not present and are weakened by the preserved hormone profile.
adversarial_second_pass.ovarian_attack: Primary ovarian insufficiency conflicts with the expected loss of ovarian negative feedback and does not explain the procedural trigger.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: Options are mechanism statements rather than diagnostic labels; the key is selected by causal localization, not wording.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No hormone threshold, adhesion percentage, procedural timing rule, fertility probability, or treatment schedule is asserted.
